sandbachFocus: Sandbach United, currently top of the table with 34 points from 16 games, face Shawbury United at home on Saturday 21 November at 15:00. The league leaders come into this fixture on the back of a recent win and have won three of their last five league matches, though they did suffer two losses in that sequence. Shawbury arrive in poor form, having won just one of their last six league outings.
divisionWide: Second-placed Wolverhampton Casuals remain locked level on points with Sandbach (both on 34) and have an impressive six consecutive league wins to their name, making them genuine title contenders. They sit idle this week. AFC Bridgnorth, currently fourth with 30 points, have two fixtures: they visit Shawbury United on Tuesday 17 November before hosting Wednesfield Community on Saturday 21 November, with recent form showing wins and draws. New Mills face Crewe on Tuesday and then travel to Alsager Town on Saturday, though both sides sit in the lower half and have struggled with inconsistency. Crewe continue to find wins hard to come by (one win in their last six) and face New Mills on Tuesday before hosting Cheadle Heath Nomads on Saturday. In the middle of the table, Stafford Town host Market Drayton Town on Saturday in a clash between two sides occupying mid-table positions. Dawley Town face Foley Meir at home on Saturday, with both teams battling to improve their league standing. Widnes Town, bottom with just 8 points, visit Brereton Social on Saturday in a fixture between two of the division's struggling sides. Finally, Alsager Town host New Mills on Saturday as they bid to find consistency after recent mixed results.
